Supreme Court asked for national fire safety framework for public buildings

A Public Interest Litigation (PIL) has been filed in the Supreme Court seeking the establishment of a uniform national fire safety framework for high-risk public buildings across India. The petition argues that the right to life includes protection from preventable fires, not just rescue after an incident. It aims to ensure consistent safety standards in places like schools and hospitals.
